text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Having searched for the vanished armor, a 
clue was finally obtained...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
With this, the whereabouts of the armor 
may become clear. Wait for me, I shall 
surely reunite you with your lord...!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Young lady, you're from back 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Durandal speaking with 
a gentleman. Overhearing the word "armor", 
I was about to call out to her when...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Gh, th-then, the armor is... the armor 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. As a result of various 
misunderstandings piling up, it seems that 
armor was handed over to a recycling 
contractor...

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
And so right now, everyone is desperately 
searching for it, or so the art space 
director told me...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the armor did not embark 
on a journey on its own two feet, but 
rather...—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It was hauled away by recycling collection 
workers... And the armor fragment and 
footprints we found were... the traces of 
that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Having seen her hard work up to this 
point and her heart empathizing with 
chivalric loyalty, I am at a complete loss 
for words.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...What a, what an outcome...! For 
something like this to, like this to...—!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Phew...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Discouraged...? Yes, quite. I cannot 
afford to be discouraged—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
We must set out to search for the armor 
this instant...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This town... No, neighboring towns and 
their vicinities, we shall scour them 
thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she raised her head, the fire of 
determination burned in her eyes. No, 
rather than that—
choice_data_list:
Weren't you disappointed that it was just 
ordinary armor...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Not in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, an armor of loyalty wandering in 
search of its lord might not have existed 
in reality.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However, a loyalty profound enough to 
inspire whispers of wandering in search of 
a master truly existed there!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The existence of this armor engraved the 
knight's loyalty into the hearts of future 
generations. ...For such armor to suffer 
such a decline!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will not permit it! That above all is 
unforgivable...! I wish to return it at 
once into the light befitting its 
devotion!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Once I have resolved to find it, I shall 
see it through. That is—the chivalry I 
have imposed upon myself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems they have not yet managed to 
identify which contractor it was...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However, that there were phone exchanges 
is certain! Then we must simply contact 
every entry in the phone book!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion! Did you happen to 
collect a suit of armor here?!

text_block_list.name: Recycling Contractor
text_block_list.text:
"Eh, ah, armor!? No, nothing that 
massive..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then could you ask among other contractors 
in the vicinity if anyone has collected 
armor? I would humbly ask to borrow your 
connections...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*...! I-I heard there is 
armor here...!!

text_block_list.name: Recycling Contractor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you made it. Yeah, it was so 
magnificent that I set it aside just in 
case~. Man, what a relief~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It was so imposing~, that armor! It was 
polished to a shine, and somehow looked so 
cheerful!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps it was cheerful? After all, 
Durandal searched so desperately to find 
it.

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It was magnificent. The armor, 
and the young lady. To be able to witness 
the sight of two knights standing side by 
side.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, fufu. To stand alongside his 
armor is an honor I shall take pride in 
for a lifetime...!
choice_data_list: Word of this exploit is going to spread!

Word of this exploit will spread, won't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, fufu. To stand alongside his 
armor is an honor I shall take pride in 
for a lifetime...!
choice_data_list: Word of this exploit is going to spread!

Word of this exploit will spread, won't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...If you speak of that, the same goes for 
you and everyone. Thanks to all of you, I 
was able to meet the armor, after all.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Without your aid, esteemed comrades, this 
miracle would never have been possible. 
—You have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Durandal's knightly adventure 
tale drew to a close. A tale of upholding 
steadfast loyalty to one's own chivalry.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Word of my exploit... will spread...?
choice_data_list:
Reporters from the local newspaper came to 
interview you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wh...at! P-Please wait a moment?! I must 
organize what I am going to say...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, on the local news page—nay. 
The adventure of the Knight Durandal was 
published in full glory.
